# Fixtures

Recorded (and, for now, synthetic) GPS traces: the regression corpus for `packages/geo` and
the input to `pnpm sim replay`.

> **Grow this corpus every time a real bus does something unexpected.** A trace that once
> produced a wrong offset, a duplicate arrival or a frozen trip is worth more than any test
> written from imagination — it is the actual failure, replayable for ever.

```
traces/<slug>.json
```

```jsonc
{
  "name": "dilsukhnagar-malakpet-synthetic",
  "synthetic": true,           // false once it comes from a real drive
  "note": "what this trace contains, and why it is here",
  "route": { "name": "…", "length_m": 2736, "stops_m": [0, 1368, 2736] },
  "pings": [{ "t": "2026-09-23T02:10:00.000Z", "lat": 17.3688, "lng": 78.5247,
              "speed_kmh": 0, "accuracy_m": 8.4 }]
}
```

Replay one through the whole ingest pipeline (needs `pnpm dev` and a published route):

```bash
pnpm sim replay tests/fixtures/traces/dilsukhnagar-malakpet-synthetic.json
```

The current file is **synthetic** — generated by the simulator along a real corridor, with a
dead zone, stalls and σ ≈ 8 m noise. It exists so the replay path is exercised and the format
is pinned. The first surveyed route replaces it with the real thing.
